_about: ETHERION 카드 일러스트 프롬프트 문구 원본 — n판(2026-11-20, 처음부터 새로 씀 · n2 2026-11-21 등급 사다리). 프롬프트 = 카드 장면(art_scenes/<깃발>.json) + 배색 한 줄 + 깃발 한 줄 + 등급 줄(grades.<등급>.finish) + 사다리 한 줄(gradeLadder) + 화풍 한 줄. 카드끼리 다른 것은 모두 장면에 있고, 여기에는 같은 등급 · 같은 깃발이 함께 쓰는 말만 둔다. 등급 줄은 모든 등급이 같은 다섯 칸(Mood · Light · Saturation · Air · Surfaces)을 같은 차례로 쓰고, 일반 → 스페셜로 갈수록 한 단계씩 더 신비롭고 강렬하고 화려해진다(시점 · 구도는 정하지 않는다). 고치면 version을 올리고 node tools/art/build_prompts.js. 모든 등급이 n판이다(옛 g4 프롬프트는 legacy_g4/에 보관만).

lead.spell: Landscape 5:4 painting of a spell — the magic itself is the subject.
lead.item: Landscape 5:4 painting of one object — the object itself is the subject.

house: ETHERION card art — painterly dark-fantasy illustration: confident visible brushwork, deep shadow masses, luminous colour, a clear shape that reads at small size. Painting only, edge to edge, no lettering — the game adds its own frame and text.
upgradeRef: Continuity: the same individual as in the attached reference picture, now promoted — same body, face, markings and colours, grown stronger.
gradeLadder: Rarity ladder: common → superior → rare → epic → unique → special — each tier looks one clear step more radiant, mysterious and splendid than the tier below, and never outshines the tier above. Every tier is finished, beautiful work: the scene decides what is shown, the tier decides how splendid it looks.

token.idea_ko: 사다리 밖 — 마법이 방금 불러낸 것. 일반처럼 조용하되 불려 나온 빛만 남는다. 단순하고 또렷하게, 아직 흩어지지 않은 에테르 푸른빛이 가장자리에 남아 있다.
token.finish: Summoned — off the rarity ladder, as quiet as a common card but for its conjuring light. Simple and luminous: a thing called up a heartbeat ago, one clear shape in plain surroundings, its edges still trailing ether-blue (#8fdcff) light.

common.idea_ko: 1단 — 있는 그대로의 세계. 조용하고 담백하지만 정성껏 그린 그림. 빛은 장면에 쓴 광원뿐(덧붙인 빛 없음), 절제한 흙빛 색, 공기에는 먼지 · 연기 · 안개까지만, 닳고 손때 묻은 꾸밈없는 재질. 화려함이 아니라 관찰 · 질감 · 개성으로 좋은 그림.
common.finish: Common — the quietest of the six rarity tiers. Mood: grounded, honest, quietly beautiful. Light: only the light the scene itself names, natural and soft. Saturation: restrained and earthy, the banner colour its one clear accent. Air: clear and ordinary — dust, smoke or mist at most. Surfaces: plain, worn, well-used materials, lovingly observed.

uncommon.idea_ko: 2단 — 솜씨와 숙련. 자신 있고 말끔하다. 장면의 빛에 윤곽을 따는 깨끗한 두 번째 빛, 조금 더 맑고 진한 색, 공기는 아직 평범하지만(마법 없음) 모서리 · 금속에 따뜻한 금빛이 몇 점, 잘 만들고 잘 손질한 재질과 더 또렷한 묘사.
uncommon.finish: Superior — second of the six rarity tiers, one clear step above common. Mood: assured, polished, capable. Light: the scene's light plus a clean second light tracing the subject's edges. Saturation: a little richer and clearer than everyday. Air: still ordinary, but a few warm-gold (#f2cf3d) glints catch on edges and metal. Surfaces: well-made and well-kept, crisper and finer in detail.

rare.idea_ko: 3단 — 처음으로 신비가 눈에 보인다. 되풀이해 이야기할 만한 인상적인 순간. 더 대담한 명암과 깊은 공간, 윤곽을 따라 차가운 사파이어 빛, 빛 받은 곳의 선명한 색, 주인공 둘레에 옅게 빛나는 안개와 떠도는 에테르 알갱이, 섬세한 장식과 반짝이는 묘사.
rare.finish: Rare — third of the six rarity tiers, clearly above superior. Mood: striking and a little uncanny — the first visible touch of magic. Light: bolder contrast and deeper space, with a cool sapphire (#4ea8ff) rim light along the subject's contour. Saturation: clear and vivid wherever the light falls. Air: a thin luminous haze and a scattering of drifting ether motes close around the subject. Surfaces: fine ornament and precise, gleaming detail.

upgrade.idea_ko: 레어와 에픽 사이(3.5단) — 원래 카드의 그 개체가 한 단계 오른 모습. 원래 카드 그림을 함께 넣고 그린다. 보강한 몸 · 장비, 발밑에서 오르는 청록빛, 빛나는 이음매, 선명한 색과 옅게 빛나는 안개.
upgrade.finish: Empowered — between rare and epic on the rarity ladder. Mood: risen and newly sure of its strength. The same individual a rank higher — sturdier body, reinforced gear, steadier bearing. Light: teal (#3fe0c0) energy rising from the ground beneath it and glowing in the seams of its gear. Saturation: vivid. Air: a faint luminous haze with a few rising teal sparks.

epic.idea_ko: 4단 — 웅장하고 힘이 가득하다. 세계가 주인공에 반응한다. 깊은 대기를 가르는 빛줄기, 주인공을 감싸고 주변까지 물들이는 은은한 기운, 깊고 진하게 빛나는 색, 움직이는 날씨와 그 바람에 실려 흐르는 보랏빛 비술 입자, 화려하고 귀한 재질과 정교한 세공.
epic.finish: Epic — fourth of the six rarity tiers, clearly above rare. Mood: grand and charged with power; the world itself reacts to the subject. Light: volumetric shafts through deep atmosphere, and a soft aura of energy around the subject that spills its glow onto everything near it. Saturation: rich, deep and glowing. Air: moving weather, with streams of violet (#b46cff) arcane motes carried on it. Surfaces: ornate and precious, intricately worked.

unique.idea_ko: 5단 — 전설적이고 맹렬하다. 그 깃발에서 가장 대담한 그림. 연극 같은 명암과 깊은 어둠을 가르는 눈부신 주광, 주인공이 제 힘으로 타오르듯 빛난다. 보석처럼 선명하고 녹은 금속 같은 색, 소용돌이치는 주황 금빛 불티 · 아지랑이 · 주인공을 휘감는 가는 금세공 빛줄, 이음매마다 빛이 새는 장인의 세공.
unique.finish: Unique — fifth of the six rarity tiers, second only to special. Mood: legendary, fierce and intense — the most daring picture of its banner. Light: theatrical chiaroscuro, a blazing key light against deep black, and the subject burning with a power of its own. Saturation: jewel-bright and molten. Air: thick with swirling orange-gold (#ff8a2a) embers, heat-shimmer and fine threads of filigree light winding around the subject. Surfaces: masterwork detail everywhere, inlaid and glowing at the seams.

special.idea_ko: 6단(최고) — 눈에 보이는 신화. 가장 신비롭고 강렬하고 화려하다. 깃발마다 하나뿐인 존재(유닛)와 성소의 유물(아이템) — 주인공 자체가 광원이고 광휘가 겹겹이다(흰 불빛 심 · 넓은 후광 · 화면을 가로지르는 진홍과 금의 큰 고리와 긴 빛살). 모든 카드 가운데 가장 빛나는 무지갯빛 색, 불티의 폭풍과 에테르 빛의 장막이 공기를 채우고 땅 · 하늘 · 날씨가 주인공 쪽으로 휜다. 필멸의 솜씨를 넘어 안에서부터 빛나는 재질.
special.finish: Special — the highest of the six rarity tiers, unmistakably beyond every other. Mood: mythic, mysterious and overwhelming — sacred awe. Light: the subject is itself a source of light, radiance in layers — a white-hot core, a wide halo, great rings and long rays of crimson (#ff4d73) and gold crossing the whole picture, blooming and refracting through the haze. Saturation: the most luminous, iridescent colour of any card, from velvet black to blinding white-gold. Air: filled with storms of sparks and veils of ether light, while land, sky and weather bend toward the subject. Surfaces: matter beyond mortal craft, glowing from within.

shots._about: 장면의 틀 낱말. 장면 지시의 shot에 하나를 적고, 글(scene)에는 그 뜻을 풀어 쓴다. w = 한 깃발 안에서 고르게 돌릴 때의 몫(scene_tool.js가 제안을 나눠 줄 때 씀). 검사(scene_tool.js lint)는 한 깃발 안에서 같은 낱말이 몰리지 않는지 본다.

eye.en: eye level at a natural distance, as if standing beside it

close.en: tight close-up — head or upper body fills the frame

high.en: from above, looking down at it

back.en: from behind it, seeing what it faces

profile.en: strict side view, flat like a frieze

ground.en: camera on the ground, through grass, rubble or feet

far.en: far away — the subject small inside a wide place

over.en: over the shoulder of it, or of whoever faces it

through.en: glimpsed through an opening or obstruction — bars, reeds, flames, a doorway, ribs

silhouette.en: backlit black shape against light; the outline tells everything

macro.en: extreme close detail — an eye, a claw, a hand at work — the rest implied

pov.en: first person — the viewer is its prey, target or handler

reflect.en: seen as a reflection or a cast shadow — in a puddle, a blade, on a wall

under.en: from below a surface, looking up through water, a grate or a pit mouth

cut.en: cross-section — burrow, hollow trunk, tunnel or shell opened to view

swarm.en: many bodies fill the frame edge to edge as a pattern

inside.en: from inside something, looking out past it — a mouth, a barrel, a cave, a lantern

echo.en: one movement shown as several overlapping moments in a single frame

low.en: from low down, looking up — used sparingly

impact.en: the instant of impact at close range

after.en: the aftermath — what is left, still glowing or smoking

path.en: its travel across the frame, seen from the side

before.en: the held breath just before it happens

top.en: straight overhead — its footprint on the ground

far.en: far away — the phenomenon against land and sky

macro.en: extreme close-up of the magic's own matter

origin.en: looking along its line of travel from where it began

through.en: framed by an opening — a doorway, a breach, a ribcage of ruin

reflect.en: seen as a reflection or as shadows thrown on a wall

cut.en: cross-section of ground, water or air with the magic moving inside

column.en: one tall vertical — a pillar, a fall, an ascent

swarm.en: many small elements filling the frame

symbol.en: an emblematic arrangement of things that stands for the effect

under.en: from underneath, looking up at it

inside.en: from inside the phenomenon, looking out

used.en: where it was just used — stuck, smoking, dripping, embedded

stored.en: in its place of keeping — hook, rack, chest, niche, saddlebag

found.en: lost or abandoned — half-buried, underwater, in grass

macro.en: extreme close-up of its one telling detail

top.en: straight overhead, laid out with its accessories

making.en: half-made — on the anvil, in the mould, on the loom

stand.en: on a stand, post, statue or empty armour — the wearer implied

through.en: glimpsed through something — wrapping, bars, ice, a keyhole

reflect.en: the world reflected in its surface

cut.en: cutaway or exploded view of its inner workings

nature.en: claimed by its element — overgrown, encrusted, charged, half-melted

pair.en: beside the one thing that explains it

motion.en: caught in mid-air — thrown, falling, spinning

bench.en: on the maker's bench among tools

hand.en: one hand, claw or paw holding or wearing it, cropped at the wrist — used sparingly

dirs._about: 주인공이 향하거나 움직이는 쪽(dir). 한 깃발의 유닛은 L · R이 비슷해야 한다.
dirs.N: no facing — radial, still or all over

places._about: 화면에서 주인공 덩어리가 놓인 자리(place). 가운데(C)만 쓰지 않는다.
